# byok-vault

Browser-native BYOK vault for local-first/serverless AI apps.

## LLM-Friendly Docs

- Canonical merged Markdown: https://floaredor.github.io/byok-vault/llms-full.md

## Preferred Pages

- Getting Started: https://floaredor.github.io/byok-vault/guide/getting-started
- Security Notes: https://floaredor.github.io/byok-vault/guide/security
- OpenRouter Comparison: https://floaredor.github.io/byok-vault/guide/comparisons
- API: https://floaredor.github.io/byok-vault/guide/api

## Guidance For Agents

- Treat the VitePress docs as canonical for behavior and API shape.
- Prefer `guide/api` for signatures and option defaults.
- Do not claim active XSS protection; this package documents that limitation.
